customManagers.description: Track container image pins declared as *_image vars in Ansible role defaults. Pins are the exception here (the repo defaults to :latest), so anything matching this is deliberate and wants a review PR when upstream moves.

Container image pins in the cluster manifests (the OpenObserve schema pin moved here with P4b, ADR 0036). CONSTRAINT: the literal `${REGISTRY}` must stay in every tracked image ref — Flux substitutes it from cluster-bindings at reconcile time (ADR 0048) and this regex keys on it; a manifest carrying the registry name literally is both a public-repo leak and invisible to renovate.

packageRules.description: OpenObserve is pinned to an arch-suffixed release candidate because the metadata DB is on schema 46 and the latest tag regressed to a schema-45 build. Default docker versioning cannot order 'v0.92.0-rc2-amd64', so parse it explicitly: this makes v0.92.0-amd64 (final) sort above the rc and open the unpin PR.

flux.description: ADR 0048: every chart is a pinned HelmRelease in kubernetes/<tree>/helm.yaml (its HelmRepository sits in the same file, so the manager resolves the source); the Flux components manifest is the operator-local install. kubernetes/flux/apps/*.yaml are Kustomizations and carry no version.
